description.value: The Mexican Antojitos y Cantina is a full-service Mexican restaurant and cantina on Vancouver's Granville Street, serving traditional antojitos, regional moles, fresh aguachile, and an extensive tequila and mezcal cocktail program. The restaurant offers both indoor and outdoor seating and hosts regular events including weekly La Lotería Night. Online ordering is available, making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through the heart of downtown Vancouver.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 62m; stands (2 spaces) at 71m; stands (4 spaces) at 74m; stands (4 spaces) at 94m. Total: 12 spaces.
